name: Q40 - strongest combined association with the incident
scored_population: entities of type PERSON, excluding the victim(s) of the incident event

spatial.definition: has a location observation at the incident location within +/- window of the incident time

temporal.definition: has any recorded activity (v_activity) within +/- window of the incident time

communication.definition: has a communication record with the victim or with anyone with a spatial signal

financial.definition: has a transaction with the victim or with anyone with a spatial signal

relational.definition: has a relationship (other than OWNS/USES) with the victim

evidence.definition: min(1, independent_evidence_sources / 3); independent source = distinct provenance origin_root (else source)

score: association_score = sum(weight * signal), rounded to 2 decimals; the five behavioural signals are BINARY (present/absent)
tie_break: association_score DESC, then entity ref ASC
validity_handling: only SUPPORTED evidence/records count (include_historical=false); CHALLENGED, INVALIDATED and SUPERSEDED records are excluded
not_used: evidence reliability_score (a per-evidence-type heuristic weight, see evidence_types) - it is used only by Q34/Q35 and in displays, NOT by Q40
weights_origin: hand-assigned ('approved heuristic weights, not probabilities' - README); not fitted to data
